name: scenic-stroll
description: Community-sourced pedestrian navigation for Hong Kong (hackathon prototype)

scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:functions && npm run test:db
scripts.deploy:functions: npm run sync-shared && npx supabase functions deploy --use-api
scripts.test:functions: npm run sync-shared && npx -y deno test --config supabase/functions/plan-trip/deno.json "supabase/functions/**/*.test.ts"
scripts.typecheck:functions: npm run sync-shared && npx -y deno check --config supabase/functions/plan-route/deno.json supabase/functions/plan-route/index.ts && npx -y deno check --config supabase/functions/geocode/deno.json supabase/functions/geocode/index.ts && npx -y deno check --config supabase/functions/conditions/deno.json supabase/functions/conditions/index.ts && npx -y deno check --config supabase/functions/smart-route/deno.json supabase/functions/smart-route/index.ts && npx -y deno check --config supabase/functions/plan-trip/deno.json supabase/functions/plan-trip/index.ts && npx -y deno check --config supabase/functions/eta/deno.json supabase/functions/eta/index.ts
